title: Static and Signal
author: Isandro Reyes
blurb: Casper Pemberton, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
